propertyNames.description: harness_id of a worker-eligible profile of the effective profile set with a headless template, a shipped or an operator-added one, or of an endpoint profile (its serving program); a profile marked headless null or worker.eligible false is never enrolled.

sha256.description: Digest of the executable at the last accepted probe.

version.description: Version printed by the profile's version probe at the last accepted probe.

updated_at.description: Last accepted self-update (equals enrolled_at before the first).

weights.description: Only for a profile whose weights_probe is not null: per allowed model id, the weights identity last read (Harness Profiles Specification, Weights Identity); a member of the qualification digest.

usage_report.description: What the harness reports of its usage (Harness Profiles Specification, Tokens, Not Money), shown in the harness list as complete, partial (naming what is missing), or not_reported. The install path maps the verification stage's `UsageResult` onto this member: `input_tokens`/`output_tokens` become `input`/`output`, each `UsageStatus` is written as its wire name (`reported`, `not_applicable`, `missing`), and `startContext` is copied unchanged.

source.description: declared: from the profile's usage pointers; verified: from the usage stage of the profile's verification.

start_context.description: Input tokens of a worker's first model turn per class and model, recorded by the profile's verification (Harness Profiles Specification, Tokens, Not Money); absent for source declared.

events.description: The per-kind results of the events stage of the profile's verification, kept with the entry (Harness Profiles Specification, What a Worker Does): each activity kind the stage checked, reported or missing. A shipped profile carries the release's results; an operator-added profile carries the results of its verification.
